title: Automated Multi-Branch CI/CD Pipeline
description: Enterprise-grade CI/CD pipeline featuring automated testing, code quality gates with SonarQube, Docker image build and push, and zero-downtime deployment.
highlights: Automated webhook triggers on GitHub push and pull request events
Integrated SonarQube static analysis with 85%+ code coverage threshold
Vulnerability scanning with Trivy before pushing to Docker Hub registry
Automated Slack notification on build failure or successful deployment
metrics: Reduced deployment lead time from 4 hours to 12 minutes

title: Production-Ready Kubernetes Microservices Cluster
description: Multi-tier microservices application deployed to Kubernetes with Nginx Ingress, Cert-Manager SSL termination, Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA), and persistent storage.
highlights: Modular Helm charts for service deployments, config maps, and secrets
Configured Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) based on CPU and memory thresholds
Network policies enforcing zero-trust communication between namespaces
Automated TLS certificate provisioning via Let's Encrypt and Cert-Manager
metrics: Maintained 99.95% uptime with self-healing pod replicas

title: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform on AWS
description: Automated provisioning of highly available AWS infrastructure using modular Terraform with remote state management and DynamoDB state locking.
highlights: Custom multi-AZ VPC architecture with public, private, and database subnets
Auto-scaling EC2 groups behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB)
Secure remote backend using Amazon S3 bucket and DynamoDB locking
CI validation pipeline running terraform fmt, validate, and tfsec
metrics: Spun up complete multi-tier cloud environment in under 6 minutes

title: Full-Stack Observability with Prometheus & Grafana
description: Centralized monitoring and metrics collection system with custom Grafana dashboards, Alertmanager integration, and automated incident alerting.
highlights: Custom Grafana dashboards tracking RED and USE metrics across nodes
Prometheus Alertmanager rules routing critical alerts via PagerDuty and Discord
Node Exporter and cAdvisor for host-level and container-level telemetry
Loki and Promtail integration for aggregated real-time log analysis
metrics: Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) degraded system health cut by 70%

title: GitOps Continuous Delivery with ArgoCD
description: Declarative GitOps continuous delivery workflow synchronizing Kubernetes application manifests from Git repositories with automatic drift detection and rollback.
highlights: Repository-driven deployments using ArgoCD ApplicationSet and Kustomize
Automated canary deployments with Argo Rollouts and Prometheus metrics
Real-time drift detection and automated remediation against manual cluster changes
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) integration with GitHub SSO
metrics: Zero manual kubectl commands executed in staging or production

title: Server Hardening & Configuration with Ansible
description: Idempotent Ansible playbooks for provisioning, security hardening, user management, and automated package management across Linux fleet instances.
highlights: CIS benchmark compliant security hardening (SSH keys, UFW firewall, fail2ban)
Dynamic inventory management for cloud and on-premises Linux targets
Ansible Vault encryption for sensitive variables, tokens, and credentials
Automated testing with Molecule and Docker test containers
metrics: Provisioned and hardened 20+ servers consistently in under 4 minutes
